title: Flashfire
subtitle: Jetpack arena combat.
description: A 2D jetpack arena shooter with six modes, eight unlockable battlegrounds and eleven weapons. Take on AI opponents, collect supply drops and master vertical combat. Keyboard, controller and landscape touch controls.
controls: A/D or arrows move; W/Up/Space uses the jetpack. Mouse aims and fires. R reloads, G throws a grenade, 1/2 switches weapon, E picks up a weapon. Escape pauses. Gamepad and landscape touch controls supported.
headline: Take flight.|Bring the fire.
heroDescription: Boost between platforms, seize fresh weapons and outmaneuver your rivals. Six modes. Eight arenas. Free to play.
caption: FLASHFIRE · BY HALLAB

presentation.note: Free to play. Progress lasts for the current visit.

replayDescription: Local single-player matches against AI. Progress and settings last for this visit and reset on reload. No cloud save or Myelin verification.
